item.title: 1 Pattern - 8 Kits - Melbourne Instruments Nina
item.description: video upload by Modern Fate "I'm sending the same pattern to eight different kits that I programmed on the Melbourne Instruments Nina. Pattern information is sent via MIDI from Ableton, to four different channels. Each kit that I load on the Nina consists of four parts respectively. Basic mastering applied, but sounds from these Nina kits only."
